title: Modular Kitchen Designer
description:
We Are Hiring | Modular Kitchen Designer

**Company:** Leading Multinational Furniture Retail Brand  
**Job Locations:** Rajarhat, Kolkata & Siliguri, West Bengal  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Permanent  
**Salary:** Up to ₹10,00,000 per annum + Attractive Performance-Based Incentives  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 5 Years in Modular Kitchen & Wardrobe Design

About the Opportunity

We are looking for experienced, creative and commercially driven Modular Kitchen Designers & Sales Executives to join a leading multinational furniture retail brand.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in modular kitchen and wardrobe design, customer consultation, technical planning and sales conversion.

This position requires complete ownership of the customer journey, from understanding design requirements and developing customised solutions to presenting proposals, managing customer relationships and successfully closing sales.

Key Responsibilities

* Design customised modular kitchens, wardrobes and storage solutions using AutoCAD (2D & 3D).
* Prepare detailed layouts, elevations, working drawings, 3D presentations and design proposals.
* Conduct customer-site visits for measurements, technical assessments and space planning.
* Prepare Bills of Quantities (BOQs), quotations, project estimates, material specifications and cost calculations.
* Recommend appropriate materials, finishes, fittings, hardware and accessories.
* Handle customer consultations, design presentations, follow-ups, negotiations and sales conversions.
* Take ownership of customer inquiries and convert qualified leads into confirmed business orders.
* Develop and maintain dealer relationships, generate business opportunities and support dealer-driven sales.
* Coordinate with production, installation and service teams to ensure timely project execution.
* Manage customer relationships from initial consultation through installation and project handover.
* Contribute to showroom revenue, customer satisfaction and overall business growth.
* Undertake customer-site visits, dealer visits and local travel as required.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience specifically in modular kitchen and wardrobe design.
* Graduate or Diploma in Interior Design, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Furniture Design or a related discipline.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD (2D & 3D).
* Working knowledge of SketchUp, KD Max, 3ds Max or equivalent design software.
* Strong knowledge of modular kitchen layouts, wardrobe internals, space planning, materials and hardware.
* Experience preparing BOQs, quotations, costing and project estimates.
* Proven experience in customer handling, design presentations, sales negotiation and order conversion.
* Exposure to dealer management, business development and lead generation.
* Good communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong customer relationship management and project coordination abilities.
* Willingness to undertake site visits and local travel.

Important Role Expectations

This is a combined **Design and Sales** position, not an exclusively design-oriented role.

The selected candidate must be comfortable handling customer consultations, dealer relationships, business development, sales targets and independent order closures.

Candidates with experience in organised furniture retail, modular kitchen companies, interior solution providers or design-and-sales environments will be preferred.

Working Hours & Benefits

**Showroom Timings:** 10:30 AM to 8:30 PM

**Weekly Off:** One day between Monday and Friday, as per roster.

Weekend availability is required due to showroom operations. Public holiday work may be required in accordance with applicable company policy and labour laws.

**Benefits:**

* Attractive annual CTC up to ₹10 LPA, depending on experience and expertise.
* Performance-based sales incentives.
* Provident Fund and applicable statutory benefits.
* Sick Leave: 12 days.
* Casual Leave: 12 days.
* Privilege Leave: 15 days, subject to applicable eligibility and company policy.
* Professional growth and career advancement opportunities.
* Exposure to premium modular kitchen and wardrobe projects.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated CV and design portfolio, mentioning:

* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Notice Period
* Preferred Job Location: Rajarhat (Kolkata) or Siliguri

**Email:** ishika.b82@gmail.com

**Subject:** Application – Modular Kitchen Designer – Preferred Location

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Motion Graphic Designer(West Bengal Candidates apply only)
description:
**SENIOR MOTION GRAPHICS DESIGNER(West Bengal Candidates apply Only)**

**Company: Devant IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.**  
Department: Design / Creative  
Experience: 2–3 Years  
Salary: ₹18,000 – ₹20,000 per month  
Employment Type: Full\-time  
Location: Kolkata  
Job Level: Mid\-Senior Level  
Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred

JOB SUMMARY: \-

Devant IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a creative and experienced Senior Motion Graphics Designer with 2–3 years of professional experience in motion graphics, animation, and video editing.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating engaging and high\-quality visual content for digital platforms, websites, social media, marketing campaigns, advertisements, presentations, and corporate communication.

The candidate should have strong creative skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage projects from concept to final delivery.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: \-

* Create high\-quality motion graphics, animations, promotional videos, and digital content.
* Convert creative briefs, scripts, and concepts into engaging visual content.
* Design motion graphics for social media, websites, advertisements, presentations, and marketing campaigns.
* Handle video editing, transitions, visual effects, typography, sound synchronization, and animation.
* Create 2D animations, logo animations, animated typography, explainer videos, and promotional creatives.
* Collaborate with the Marketing, Content, UI/UX, Graphic Design, and Development teams.
* Understand project requirements and deliver creative output within defined timelines.
* Ensure consistency with company branding and visual guidelines.
* Review and revise creative work based on management and team feedback.
* Manage multiple creative projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and deadlines.
* Stay updated with the latest motion design trends, animation techniques, AI\-powered creative tools, and digital content trends.

REQUIRED SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE: \-

* 2–3 years of professional experience in Motion Graphics, Animation, and Video Editing.
* Strong proficiency in Adobe After Effects.
* Good working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro.
* Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.
* Strong understanding of motion design, animation principles, typography, composition, visual effects, and visual storytelling.
* Hands\-on experience in video editing, transitions, effects, and sound synchronization.
* Knowledge of 2D animation and motion graphics production workflows.
* Familiarity with AI\-powered creative and design tools will be an added advantage.
* Strong creative thinking and attention to detail.
* Ability to understand creative briefs and independently execute projects.
* Ability to work within deadlines and handle multiple projects effectively.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:\-

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Animation, Multimedia, Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field is preferred.
* Candidates with a strong portfolio/showreel will be given preference.
* Experience creating content for social media, digital marketing, advertisements, and corporate branding will be an added advantage.

HOW TO APPLY:\-

Interested candidates may share their updated CV and portfolio/showreel with:

Email: talentacquisition@devantitsolutions.com  
Contact: 7605083834

Pay: ₹22,928\.34 \- ₹25,707\.09 per month

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* English (Preferred)

title: Graphic Designer Internship
description:
Digiad Solution Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a creative and enthusiastic Graphic Designer Intern to join our team. We are mainly looking for someone who is comfortable using Canva and has a good sense of design.

Freshers, students, and candidates from any educational background are welcome to apply. If you are creative, willing to learn, and interested in social media design, this opportunity is for you.

What You'll Do:

* Create social media posts, banners, promotional creatives, and marketing designs using Canva.
* Design creative content for Instagram, Facebook, and other digital platforms.
* Work on different design concepts based on brand requirements.
* Edit and improve existing designs.
* Explore new design trends and creative ideas.
* Assist the marketing team with day\-to\-day design requirements.

Requirements:

* Good knowledge of Canva.
* Basic understanding of colours, fonts, layouts, and visual composition.
* Creativity and attention to detail.
* Willingness to learn and improve design skills.
* Basic knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, or AI design tools is a plus, but not mandatory.

Who Can Apply:

* Freshers
* Students
* Candidates with or without prior work experience
* Candidates from any educational background
* Anyone with a genuine interest in graphic design and Canva

Job Type: Internship  
Location: Kolkata  
Experience: Fresher / 0–1 year

If you enjoy creating designs and want to gain practical experience while working on real projects, we would love to hear from you.

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 per month
